SCOUT.SUBHEADER: AI-powered commercial SDR and sales qualification assistants
SCOUT.NO_CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTES: No custom attributes defined in account settings yet.
SCOUT.CONFIRM_DELETE_MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete this Scout? This action cannot be undone.
SCOUT.API_KEY_OVERRIDE_PLACEHOLDER: Leave empty to use account/system default key

EMPTY_STATE.TITLE: No Scouts Configured
EMPTY_STATE.DESCRIPTION: Create your first commercial AI assistant to qualify leads, pitch products, and drive pipeline conversions automatically.

CREATE_MODAL.TITLE: Create New Scout
CREATE_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Configure your commercial SDR assistant parameters.

GENERAL.TITLE: General Configuration
GENERAL.SUBTITLE: Manage name, persona instructions, and execution boundaries.
GENERAL.PERSONA_PLACEHOLDER: Instruct the Scout on its personality, communication tone, and commercial guidelines...
GENERAL.PERSONA_HINT: Define qualification criteria, objection handling tone, and product pitch instructions.
GENERAL.DEBOUNCE_HINT: Time to wait for consecutive messages before generating an LLM response.
GENERAL.QUOTA_HINT: Maximum number of AI responses per billing cycle (-1 for no limit).

INBOXES.TITLE: Connected Inboxes
INBOXES.SUBTITLE: Manage channels where this Scout responds to incoming leads.
INBOXES.EMPTY_DESC: Connect inboxes so this Scout can start qualifying incoming conversations.
INBOXES.CONFIRM_DETACH: Are you sure you want to disconnect this inbox from the Scout?
INBOXES.ATTACH_MODAL_DESC: Select an inbox to attach to this Scout assistant.
INBOXES.REASSIGN_WARNING: If this inbox is connected to another Scout, it will be reassigned.

PRODUCTS.TITLE: Product & Offer Catalog
PRODUCTS.SUBTITLE: Configure products and value propositions for commercial pitches.
PRODUCTS.EMPTY_DESC: Add products or service tiers to your catalog so Scout can present offers and pricing.
PRODUCTS.CONFIRM_DELETE: Are you sure you want to delete this product from the catalog?

MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Define product features, pricing, and key value propositions.
MODAL.VALUE_PROP_PLACEHOLDER: Describe primary differentiators, benefits, and target audience...

KNOWLEDGE.TITLE: Knowledge Base & FAQs
KNOWLEDGE.SUBTITLE: Provide reference URLs, PDF materials, and objection FAQs.
KNOWLEDGE.EMPTY_DESC: Add URLs, PDF files (up to 10MB), or FAQ entries to train your Scout with company knowledge.
KNOWLEDGE.CONFIRM_DELETE: Are you sure you want to delete this knowledge source?

MODAL.TITLE: Add Knowledge Source
MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Choose the type of source to ingest into the Scout's knowledge base.
MODAL.URL_HINT: Scout will crawl and extract text content from this URL.
MODAL.QUESTION_PLACEHOLDER: e.g., What is your refund policy?
MODAL.ANSWER_PLACEHOLDER: Enter talking points and approved objection handling response...

FUNNEL.TITLE: Pipeline Funnel & Qualification
FUNNEL.SUBTITLE: Configure automatic CRM stage transitions and required qualification fields.
FUNNEL.DEFAULT_STAGE_HINT: Stage where newly created opportunities from leads start.
FUNNEL.QUALIFIED_STAGE_HINT: Stage to move the opportunity when qualification criteria are met.
FUNNEL.UNQUALIFIED_STAGE_HINT: Stage to move when lead does not match commercial criteria.
FUNNEL.HANDOVER_TEAM_HINT: Team assigned when Scout transfers the conversation to human agents.
FUNNEL.REQUIRED_FIELDS_SUBTITLE: Select contact and opportunity custom attributes that Scout must collect before qualifying.
FUNNEL.NO_ATTRIBUTES_AVAILABLE: No custom attributes configured in account settings.

TOOLS.TITLE: Tools
TOOLS.SUBTITLE: Configure external API tools that Scouts can invoke during conversations.
TOOLS.EMPTY_DESC: Create tools to allow Scouts to query external systems or trigger automations.
TOOLS.CONFIRM_DELETE: Are you sure you want to delete this tool?

MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Configure HTTP endpoint, authentication headers, and JSON Schema parameters.
MODAL.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Explain to the AI when and why to invoke this tool...
MODAL.INVALID_SCHEMA_JSON: Parameters schema must be valid JSON Schema.

PLAYGROUND.TITLE: Interactive Playground
PLAYGROUND.DESCRIPTION: Test Scout behavior in a sandbox. Native tools are safely simulated; external tools call live endpoints.
PLAYGROUND.EMPTY_CHAT_DESC: Send a customer message below to test Scout's qualification, knowledge base, and tool execution.
PLAYGROUND.INPUT_PLACEHOLDER: Type a test message and press Enter...
PLAYGROUND.DISCLAIMER: Playground conversations do not affect live inbox metrics or conversation lists.

PROVIDER_SETTINGS.TITLE: Scout AI Provider Configuration
PROVIDER_SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Configure default AI providers, model parameters, and API credentials (Admin Only).
PROVIDER_SETTINGS.API_KEY_CONFIGURED_HINT: API Key configured (leave blank to keep current)
PROVIDER_SETTINGS.API_KEY_SECURITY_NOTE: API keys are encrypted in the database and never sent to browser clients.
